name: godot_install_host
description: Install or update OpenCode Link (the version of this plugin) in a Godot project: its add-on folder addons/opencode_link and its project.godot's enabled editor plugins. project: the project folder; by default the attached editor's project, else the conversation's folder. Asks permission; restart that project's editor afterwards if it is open.

project.description: A Godot project folder (with project.godot), absolute or relative to the conversation's folder.
